milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' means the player has navigated close to and is looking at the oak log tree structure. The oak logs are placed at spawn-relative coordinates ~6,0-2,4 area. Target is set to the center of the log cluster at [6, 1, 4] with max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 to model 'player can see the logs'.

Uses inventory_has because mining the dark_oak_pressure_plate causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. There is exactly one dark_oak_pressure_plate in the scene (placed at ~8,1,3) and none in starting inventory, so having one in inventory definitively proves mining occurred.

Uses inventory_has because crafting sandstone (4 sand → 1 sandstone in a 2x2 grid) places the result in the player's inventory. No sandstone exists in the scene initially and the player starts with 16 sand, so having sandstone in inventory proves successful crafting.

Uses inventory_has because crafting sandstone slabs (3 sandstone in a row → 6 slabs, requires crafting table's 3x3 grid) places the result in the player's inventory. No sandstone_slab exists in the scene initially, so having one in inventory proves successful crafting from sandstone.
